name: Disneyland Jolly Holiday Giant Warm Mickey-Shaped Cinnamon Roll
whyItWorks: Iconic three-circle Mickey yeast dough swirled with cinnamon and brown sugar, topped with warm vanilla cream cheese icing. Soft, seed-free, and great to share.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the cinnamon roll warmed up; share among 2 people.
watchOuts: High sugar volume; share to avoid rapid gastric emptying
